Coconut Cove by Oversee | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Coconut Cove, a delightful mix of style, space, and relaxation!Ideal for families or friends, this home is the getaway you’ve been dreaming of. Step inside and get ready to kick back. The foyer opens to a spacious living room, complete with a cozy full-size bed for extra guests (or a nap, we won’t judge). The first floor also has a chef-worthy kitchen with all the top appliances, a large dining room perfect for family feasts, and a backyard that’s basically a vacation of its own. Speaking of the backyard, get ready to indulge. A stunning pool and spa spill into each other, creating the ultimate spot for poolside lounging, spa relaxation, or dining under the stars.

The outdoor patio is perfect for making memories over dinner, drinks, or just a chill afternoon. Each Primary bedroom is designed to give you the ultimate unwind, with luxurious linens and plenty of space to stretch out. Whether you want a quiet retreat or a lively stay with loved ones, Coconut Cove is just the place! Tucked away in a peaceful neighborhood, you’re still close to all the good stuff—beaches, restaurants, and shopping. So, explore the area by day and come back to your own slice of paradise by night. Book your stay today and make Coconut Cove your new favorite escape! At Oversee 30A, we’re all about giving you a top-tier experience. We’re a local team and just a quick call away, available seven days a week with a 24/7 emergency line to make sure your stay is stress-free. Overview: - .5 miles to the beach (San Juan Beach Access) - 5 bedrooms, 5 bath - 2684 sq ft - 25 ft by 15 ft pool - Private pool w/ spillover spa (pool can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Outdoor shower - Parking for 4 vehicles comfortably - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, shared hall bath, TV - Full sofa-bed in living room, shared hall bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Primary Bedroom: Queen bed, private bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
